text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear a particularly loud voice while I'm
walking
down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Wanna give this riddle a go?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry, I can't! I have training to get
to...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! Fancy a special riddle? It comes
with a
big surprise and everything!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but the teacher wants to speak
with me...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Did we just make eye contact?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Good timing, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, one of my pals told me an awful

interesting riddle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Think ya got what it takes to
solve it?
Let's get to riddlin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What's orange and sounds like a pigeon?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bingo! Got it in one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You sure are somethin', Trainer! I still
can't make
heads or tails of it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I ain't never heard a carrot
sound like
anything...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! As long as everybody's
having
fun, that's good enough!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm gonna go ask more people this
riddle,
then! See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, all this carrot talk's got my
tummy
rumbling.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll save the riddlin' for another
time. See
ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, guess you're stuck! The
answer's "a
carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I had some trouble at first
too.
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Actually, why is "carrot" the answer? Carrots don't sound like pigeons.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... Ya know what? You're right! It is supposed to be "parrot"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Carrot... sounds like "parrot." That makes
total
sense!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a million, Trainer! You big
smarty-pants,
you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now I gotta go let everybody know! See
ya!
